purpose: Preserve origin, authorship, contribution, rights, transformations and accountability for every promotable knowledge artifact without erasing prior authors or converting unknown origin into assumed ownership.

authorship_invariant.name: IGC_AUTHORSHIP_PROVENANCE
authorship_invariant.formula: VALID_ATTRIBUTION(a)=IDENTITY(a) AND CONTRIBUTION(a) AND ORIGIN_CHAIN(a) AND RIGHTS_STATE(a) AND ACCOUNTABILITY(a) AND NOT BLOCKING_UNCERTAINTY(a)
invariants: origin is never silently replaced by the latest transmitter
derivation preserves every known upstream author and source revision
authors, contributors, editors, translators, curators, reviewers and tools remain distinct roles
unknown or disputed authorship is TOKEN_VAZIO_AUTHORSHIP, never project ownership by default
corrections supersede records but do not delete historical attribution
implementation of a prior concept does not erase the concept source
independent contribution may be credited without claiming ownership of upstream material
AI-assisted systems are disclosed as tools or assistance and are not accountable human authors
promotion is blocked when attribution, permission or source identity is materially unresolved

block_when: substantial words, results, data, code, figures or distinctive structure are used without an adequate source anchor
another person's contribution is presented as solely created by the current project
a source is cited but the copied or adapted portion is not distinguishable
a translation, adaptation, compilation or implementation hides the upstream work
an author is added without a documented contribution or accountability basis
permission or license required for reuse is unresolved
the origin is unknown and the artifact is nevertheless promoted as original
not_automatically_plagiarism: honest error preserved and corrected append-only
use of ideas, methods or mathematical concepts with appropriate scholarly attribution where ethically required, while preserving the distinction between an idea and its protected expression
short conventional technical phrases that do not materially misrepresent contribution

perpetual_preservation.correction_method: append a superseding record linked by previous_record_id
